bio.text: Colleen Burton represents District 12 in the Florida Senate, to which Burton was elected in 2022, and served in the Florida House of Representatives from 2014 to 2022.
The Senate lists Burton as a former nonprofit executive director with Polk Vision and the Imperial Symphony Orchestra.
Burton holds a B.S. in public administration from California State University, Sacramento (1980) and was born in Heidelberg, Germany. Burton moved to Florida in 1987.
